acceptance_predicates.description: asb tool install supported-id needs no manual source/version/kind input and deterministically chooses verified reuse, official prebuilt, or pinned source fallback.
A tool is registered active only after adapter-specific entrypoint smoke verification succeeds.
Status, repair, update, and remove expose exact acquisition/build state without hidden downloads on read-only commands and retain prior usable state on failure.
Local-file and fixture modes are explicit development/import paths and cannot be confused with a verified supported installation.
Human output explains acquisition/build outcome and next action while JSON/quiet/privacy contracts remain intact.

definition_of_done: Fresh project installations and lifecycle operations qualify every supported tool fixture and representative official path.
Independent review and exact-head/exact-main evidence pass.

outputs.description: Default public supported-ID installer with verified usable registration.

gates.description: Fresh project supported-ID installs produce usable verified entries.
